rows.item: Two leaderboards disagree on whether any strategy passes every gate
rows.evidence: The landing page says one of sixteen strategies passes all gates (data/site/payload.json, Wind — under). The line-desk leaderboard shows 0 of 8 through all gates (data/lab/leaderboard.json). The requirements register says none has cleared the economic gates (data/audit/requirements_assessed.json, R-09).
rows.done: Recorded, not resolved. The readiness row for R-09 names both counts.
rows.settles: One leaderboard file, generated by one script, with its gate results; then the landing page quotes that file only.

rows.item: Three different model-error figures are published for the same model
rows.evidence: The landing page and generator text say spread MAE 10.42 against a market 9.73 (tools/build_app.py). The line-desk model report gives side MAE 10.741 against 9.792 (data/lab/lines/model_report.json). The payload summary gives mean margin MAE 10.98 across 2000–2026 (data/site/payload.json).
rows.done: Recorded. Each figure is labelled with its source file in the readiness register.
rows.settles: Name one test window and one script that writes the figure; regenerate every page from it.

rows.item: The market benchmark 9.73 is typed into the generator, not computed
rows.evidence: tools/build_app.py contains 9.73 on six lines. The value in the model report is 9.792 (data/lab/lines/model_report.json, accuracy.side_mae_market).
rows.done: Recorded only. The landing text is not changed by this session.
rows.settles: Replace the constant with a read from the model report.

rows.item: The scheduled refresh succeeds but stores only one capture date and no fetch time
rows.evidence: Recent data-refresh runs on main completed successfully (gh run list --workflow data-refresh.yml). All 345 rows of data/injuries/injuries_2026_week10.csv carry one snapshot date, 'snapshot 2026-11-14', and no fetch time.
rows.done: Recorded. The readiness rows R-19 and NB-11 show the gap as a count.
rows.settles: Write a dated, hashed file per capture and make the generator read the newest one.

rows.item: The same Week 10 injury report is stored in three files with different layouts
rows.evidence: data/injuries_2026_week10.csv, data/injuries/injuries_2026_week10.csv and data/console/injuries_week10.csv hold the league report in three schemas, with 345/345/345 rows.
rows.settles: Name one canonical file; generate the others from it.

rows.item: Compiled Python files are tracked in Git and change on every build
rows.evidence: code/__pycache__/*.pyc is tracked; running the builders modifies it, so the tree is never clean after a build.
rows.done: Local modification reverted before commit. Not removed from history.
rows.settles: Add __pycache__ to .gitignore and untrack the files (an owner-approved change).

rows.item: The site links 8 different stylesheet files across its page trees
rows.evidence: Counted by tools/build_readiness.py from every local stylesheet link in the page trees (see R-25 on the readiness register).
rows.settles: Owner decision on one stylesheet; a single build step then regenerates the trees.

rows.item: The published Week 10 injury table is missing 2 official rows and differs in 16 rows
rows.evidence: A re-capture of https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ read on 2026-11-15 (session arena-ed8c600d-x1, merged to main in PR #49) finds 347 official rows against 345 published, 2 official rows absent from the published table (for example BAL: Calais Campbell), and 32 status cells in 16 matched rows that differ. The published page's own status counts also differ from the official ones. The figures are attributed to that report, not re-verified row by row here.
rows.done: Recorded. The published table was not changed in this session; the capture report is merged beside it.
rows.settles: Re-generate the table from the dated capture, then re-run the row-level comparison; publish the difference rather than the old count.

rows.item: The NFL terms-of-use address returns a 404 page, and no terms are on record
rows.evidence: No NFL terms document is recorded in this repository. The address https://www.nfl.com/terms-of-use returned a 404 page when checked on 2026-11-15, so the terms that govern the public-versus-private data decision (NB-10) have not been read.
rows.done: Recorded. The NB-10 row names the terms as unread. The link is the league home page, from which the current terms should be found; the broken address is not linked.
rows.settles: Locate the current terms page on nfl.com and record its text and date.
